title: One gold, three *colours*
hero_alt: Three Pavé beads in yellow, white and rose 916 gold on teal suede
dek: What 1C, 2C and 3C mean on our labels, and how to choose between them.

body.html: Every bead and pipe we make is 916 gold. What changes is its colour, and on our labels you will see one of three codes.

Yellow (1C) is the classic, and the warmest against the skin. Two-tone (2C) adds white gold, finished in rhodium, for contrast; it sits well beside a steel watch. Tri-tone (3C) mixes yellow, white and rose gold for the most movement.
Not every design is made in every colour. Ask at any boutique which colours are available for the design you like.
